notes: הַשָּׁנָה is rendered this year, so the article takes the determiner written in its place (rule 41).
Both ordinal agreement articles are unrepresented beside the phrase's single written the (rule 47).
סָפִיחַ and סָחִישׁ are anarthrous substantives taking the whole supplied noun phrase, headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 46, 31).
